rows.grounds: nominal subject indicating elevation; architectural measure
instrumental compound specifying proportional measure; sva+tri+bhāga
genitive plural denoting the ambulatory passages whose height is specified
predicate noun restating the resulting height of the passages

items.question: By what proportional measure is the elevation of circumambulation passages determined?
premises: The circumambulation passages possess a measurable elevation.
This elevation is calculated in relation to an own height.
The specified proportion is one third part.
items.inference: The elevation of the circumambulation passages equals one third of its own height.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the base height implied by sva is not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: The elevation of the circumambulation passages is one third of its own height.
